current_milestone: The program now contains both strict evidence/safety infrastructure and measurable capability-growth kernels. ProgramInductionLearner learns uniquely identified procedures from demonstrations and transfers them to evaluator-held queries across numeric, string, and sequence domains while preserving learned skills across snapshot reload and rejecting corrupt or ambiguous updates. CompositionalLearner synthesizes new procedures from primitives and can reuse an earlier learned skill as a macro to acquire a deeper behavior within the same search-term budget, with held-out queries and protected-baseline regression checks. These are deliberately bounded development mechanisms and are not AGI evidence.

claim_boundary: No intermediate architecture, CI/reference result, bounded induction/composition campaign, development-model run, internal regression decision, unsigned/self-produced result, or unverified independence assertion counts as verified AGI. A verified AGI claim requires the conservative external production evidence gate to pass on genuinely independent, auditable evidence without unresolved failures or contamination.
